combinations.name: Mount Void Crystal onto Lantern
combinations.text: You mount the void crystal inside the lantern housing. The flame turns brilliant spectral blue, cutting through deep shadows.

combinations.name: Fit Clarity Crystal Prism into Lantern
combinations.text: You seat the clarity crystal prism behind the brass lens. A piercing white beam cuts through the shifting gloom.

combinations.name: Compound Entity Ash in Empty Vial
combinations.text: You suspend the fine entity ash inside the laboratory vial, producing a crisp, invigorating clarity tonic.

combinations.name: Refine Ash Dust Vial into Clarity Tonic
combinations.text: You decant the ash dust into the stoppered laboratory vial, yielding an invigorating clarity elixir.

combinations.name: Hone Razor Edge with Glass Shard
combinations.text: You draw the razor edge across the beveled glass shard until the steel gleams with surgical lethality.

combinations.name: Bind Entity Cloth to Void Crystal
combinations.text: You bind the floating entity cloth around the crystal core, fashioning a talisman that wards off creeping dread.

combinations.name: Distill Void Resin into Pain Medication
combinations.text: You filter dark doorframe resin through sterile clinical cloth into a concentrated, full-strength analgesic dose.
